mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly demand (GDPC1) over the past month predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to expectations of higher inflation and tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0%, or the rate rise is temporary and reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to inflationary concerns and weak labor market.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.0%, or the rate increase is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in quarterly demand (GDPC1) signal accommodative policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1, or the policy shift reverses.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in federal funds rates predicts stronger positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced policy tightness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to outperform baseline in late-cycle expansion periods, or the FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the monthly supply index (INDPRO) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as increased production capacity supports market growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth, or the supply increase reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in unemployment rates signal accommodative policy and labor market concerns, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE, or the policy shift reverses.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly demand (HOUST) exceeds 500 units, it signals over-optimism, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to potential market overvaluation.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite HOUST exceeding 500, or the demand surge reverses.
